title: Repairing interfacial defects via preferable adsorption of ytterbium for high-utilization and dendrite-free Zn metal anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05382F, Paper
Long Jiang, Zhenyue Xing, Yanfen Liu, Xiaodong Shi, Le Li, Yangyang Liu, Bingan Lu, Jiang Zhou
Base on the 2–0.15Yb electrolyte with rapid migration kinetics, homogeneous nucleation and (002)-oriented electrodeposition are achieved by repairing the surface defects with high reactivity, resulting in a highly stable Zn anode.
